quests.question: This person imagines a clever new tool and then builds it.
quests.hint: This person imagines a clever new tool and then builds it.
quests.explanation: That's right! This is an inventor. Inventors design and create brand-new things that did not exist before.
quests.funFact: An inventor often fails many times before finally getting an idea to work.
quests.wordExample: The inventor built a brand-new kind of umbrella.

quests.question: This person crosses threads together on a loom to make cloth.

quests.wordExample: The weaver crossed the colorful threads on her loom.
